notes.en: Error codes (cells-core Error): 20 MalformedAccountData, 21 WitnessHashMismatch, 23 UnknownAction, 24 NotInPredecessorRange, 25 LinkedListBroken, 27 StructuralDrift, 28 NotExpired, 29 Unauthorized, 30 InvalidCharset, 31 InvalidLength, 34 GenesisSeedMissing, 35 InsufficientPrice, 36 CommitMissing, 37 CommitTooYoung, 38 NullOwner, 39 ExpiryTooSoon, 40 ParentMissing, 41 ParentOutlived, 42 TreasuryUnpaid, 43 TermTooLong, 44 OwnerIsCellLock, 45 TooDeep, 46 RootNotRecyclable, 47 CommitNotOwned, 48 CellLockNotAccountLock; 4 Encoding (syscall / args too short).

notes.zh: 同意（consents）：ACP / anyone-can-pay Omnilock / PW-Lock 输入不算同意；input-type-proxy-lock（deed）需其 args 指向的 type cell 在同意的 lock 下被花费（最多 2 层）；sale-lock 输入只同意 transfer。
notes.en: Consent: ACP / anyone-can-pay Omnilock / PW-Lock inputs give none; an input-type-proxy-lock (deed) consents only if the type cell in its args is spent under a consenting lock (≤ 2 levels); a sale-lock input consents to transfer only.

notes.zh: 不校验签名：授权完全靠“花费 owner lock 下的 cell”。合约可由单 key / multisig 升级（docs/TRUST.md）。
notes.en: No signatures checked: authorization is “spend a cell under the owner lock”. The contracts are upgradeable by a key/multisig (docs/TRUST.md).
